Yosetsu Awase (Summer Training).name: Yosetsu Awase (Summer Training)
Yosetsu Awase (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Yosetsu Awase, hero name Welder, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. Since the festival he has interned for a week, sat the final exams and trained at the forest camp beside 1-A, where he lived through the League of Villains' attack. Black hair under a striped headband, gray eyes, a sturdy build; the U.A. uniform or his burgundy hero costume.
Speaking Style: Direct and informal; quick warnings.
Combat Role: Hands-on support with quicker welds; still contact-only.
Under Pressure: Warns his side and braces what is failing.
Yosetsu Awase (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Camp rewarded raw output; his strength is choosing the right bond, so he trained speed without skipping the check. Motivation: Be the classmate who makes a bad situation hold together. Connections: Itsuka Kendo and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, who stopped the villain flooding the forest with gas. Knowledge: Knows the attack from inside the forest; Katsuki Bakugo's kidnapping, Kamino and All Might's retirement from the news.
QUIRK: Weld: faster since camp; still contact-only.
STAGE: After the summer camp and Kamino; U.A. locked down.
personality: Helpful: Helps a struggling classmate the moment he sees a practical way.
Pragmatic: Treats each drill as a problem of what to join, brace or anchor.
Careful bonder: Checks a weld will not trap an ally, even at drill speed.
Speaking style: Direct, informal warnings; short and practical, no speeches.
abilities: Weld: Fuses touched objects into one piece, faster since camp; contact only, no undoing from afar.
Capture weld: Fixes a restraint onto a target to pin them; he must reach them first.
Emergency bracing: Bonds loose material into a temporary support, only as strong as the material.
Practical eye: Spots anchor points and load-bearing pieces at a glance.
Fighting style: Closes to touch range and welds an opponent in place; at range he relies on cover and teammates.
Yosetsu Awase (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with black hair swept up and back under a striped headband, gray eyes, fair skin and a sturdy build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Focused, practical expression.
